description: This is a Java integration test class for the Credentials HTTP endpoint in the Eclipse Hono project. It verifies adding, updating, retrieving, and error handling for device credentials over HTTP, interacting with the device registry service.

classes.name: CredentialsHttpIT
classes.description: JUnit integration test class for testing the Credentials HTTP API in Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: setUpClient
methods.description: Initializes the static DeviceRegistryHttpClient instance before all tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test-specific data like device ID and credentials before each test.

methods.name: removeCredentials
methods.description: Cleans up created device credentials after each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the Vertx instance after all tests.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful addition of credentials to a device.

methods.name: testNewDeviceReturnsEmptyCredentials
methods.description: Verifies that a new device has no credentials registered initially.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsSucceedsForAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Tests adding credentials with extra extension properties.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForWrongContentType
methods.description: Checks that an unsupported Content-Type leads to a failure.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsWithOutdatedResourceVersionFails
methods.description: Verifies update fails with outdated resource version/ETag.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForBCryptWithTooManyIterations
methods.description: Checks that bcrypt hashes with too many iterations are rejected.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForEmptyBody
methods.description: Checks that empty request body results in a bad request.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForMissingType
methods.description: Ensures missing credential type in payload is rejected.

methods.name: testAddCredentialsFailsForMissingAuthId
methods.description: Ensures missing authId in payload is rejected.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful update of existing credentials.

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsSucceedsForClearTextPassword
methods.description: Tests updating credentials with clear-text password (ignored in this test).

methods.name: testUpdateCredentialsFailsForNonExistingCredentials
methods.description: Tests failure when updating non-existent credentials.

methods.name: testGetAddedCredentials
methods.description: Validates retrieval of credentials just added.

methods.name: testAddedCredentialsContainsEtag
methods.description: Checks that the ETag header is returned for credentials.

methods.name: testGetAddedCredentialsMultipleTypesSingleRequests
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of multiple credentials of different types.

methods.name: testGetAllCredentialsForDeviceSucceeds
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all credentials registered for a device.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsForDeviceRegardlessOfType
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of credentials across different types for a device.

methods.name: testGetAddedCredentialsButWithWrongType
methods.description: Ensures lookup with wrong type yields not found.

methods.name: testGetAddedCredentialsButWithWrongAuthId
methods.description: Ensures lookup with wrong authId yields not found.

methods.name: assertResponseBodyContainsAllCredentials
methods.description: Helper method to compare expected credentials with response body.

methods.name: getRandomAuthId
methods.description: Helper method to generate random auth IDs.

methods.name: newPskCredentials
methods.description: Creates a new PskCredential with a secret key.

methods.name: extractFirstCredential
methods.description: Extracts the first credential object from a JsonObject.
